verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents a REST API for driving local models from apps and scripts. It also serves OpenAI-like endpoints locally and on the network, with headless operation and on-demand model loading by request, and community users confirm the OpenAI-compatible server works for real tooling. missing for 10: a detailed endpoint and reference documentation excerpt, and evidence that model management and configuration (beyond inference and on-demand loading) are drivable via the API rather than the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: LM Studio provides a REST API that you can use to interact with your local models from your own apps and scripts.
Serve local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network
to use a model, simply send an inferencing request to it. If the model is not yet loaded, it'll be loaded before your request returns.
the OpenAI server makes it really easy to spin up a server and test
